name: research/inclusion_did.py:N_CONTROLS

name: research/inclusion_did.py:N_MEMBERS
justification: Incumbent members sampled per event for the mean correlation; the mean of 50 correlations has small sampling error relative to the effects measured, at bounded compute.

name: research/inclusion_did.py:PRETREND_BINS

name: research/inclusion_did.py:PRE_BARS

name: research/inclusion_did.py:RUNUP_SHORTLIST
